svg.text: MPx Squeeze v1 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. Item 10: male 28 PCO 1881 neck (T 27.40 ±0.13, lip flat and Ra ≤ 0.8) so it screws into item 1 like a bottle.
2. Item 11 converts M24×1 female-spout taps to M22×1; item 12 fits plain round spouts Ø14–22 (silicone cone + 316L worm clamp).
3. Item 13: backflush coupler; its PCO side takes a bottle of clean water or item 10, its M14×1 side screws onto the stem with the sleeve open.
4. All tap-side faces sealed with S6 (Ø22/Ø16 × 2 silicone).
